title: Screening potential anti-osteoarthritis compounds using molecular docking based on MAPK and NFkappaB pathways and validating their anti-osteoarthritis effect.
authors: Zhu, Tian-Wang; Zheng, Yu; Li, Rui-Xin
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接筛选抗骨关节炎化合物，靶向MAPK/NFkappaB通路蛋白，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法创新，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Osteoarthritis is an extremely common disease. However, it lacks effective nonsurgical treatments. Molecular docking has been widely used in drug discovery. However, no studies focus on screening anti-osteoarthritis compounds using molecular docking. This study aimed to screen potential anti-osteoarthritis compounds using molecular docking and validate their anti-osteoarthritis effect. Molecular dockings between 51 compounds inhibiting the MAPK and NFkappaB pathways but have not been used to treat osteoarthritis and 5 core human proteins in the MAPK and NFkappaB pathways were performed. Corilagin, Apigetrin, Protopine, 5-methoxyflavone, and 7,3',4'-trihydroxyisoflavone were selected. The drug-likeness, pharmacokinetics, bioactivity, and toxicity of the selected compounds were analyzed. The cytotoxicity and anti-osteoarthritis effect of the selected compounds were tested on mouse chondrocytes. This study found that molecular docking based on the MAPK and NFkappaB pathways can be used to screen potential anti-osteoarthritis compounds, providing a perspective on drug discovery through pathway-based screening. ERK2, JNK2, and p38 showed similar binding sites commonly interacting with the compounds. The theoretical drug-likeness, pharmacokinetics, bioactivity, and toxicity were largely consistent with the empirical cytotoxicity and anti-osteoarthritis effect. Additionally, Protopine, 5-methoxyflavone, and 7,3',4'-trihydroxyisoflavone showed strong anti-osteoarthritis potential and can be considered for future studies to test their anti-osteoarthritis effect in animal models, explore molecular mechanisms, and improve their solubility.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎是一种极为常见的疾病。然而，目前缺乏有效的非手术治疗方法。分子对接 (molecular docking) 已被广泛应用于药物发现领域。但尚无研究聚焦于利用分子对接筛选抗骨关节炎化合物。本研究旨在通过分子对接筛选潜在的抗骨关节炎化合物，并验证其抗骨关节炎效果。本研究对51种抑制MAPK和NFkappaB通路但尚未用于治疗骨关节炎的化合物，与MAPK和NFkappaB通路中的5种核心人类蛋白进行了分子对接。筛选出Corilagin、Apigetrin、Protopine、5-methoxyflavone和7,3',4'-trihydroxyisoflavone。对所选化合物的类药性、药代动力学、生物活性和毒性进行了分析。在小鼠软骨细胞上测试了所选化合物的细胞毒性和抗骨关节炎效果。本研究发现，基于MAPK和NFkappaB通路的分子对接可用于筛选潜在的抗骨关节炎化合物，为通过通路筛选进行药物发现提供了新视角。ERK2、JNK2和p38显示出相似的结合位点，通常与这些化合物相互作用。理论上的类药性、药代动力学、生物活性和毒性结果与实验测得的细胞毒性和抗骨关节炎效果大体一致。此外，Protopine、5-methoxyflavone和7,3',4'-trihydroxyisoflavone显示出较强的抗骨关节炎潜力，可考虑用于未来研究，以在动物模型中测试其抗骨关节炎效果、探索分子机制并改善其溶解性。
